reason: A DeepSeek Harness interface plugin that provides an artifact and workspace file-tree sidebar, previews common file types, and opens the panel in a separate browser tab.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可弹出的产物与工作区文件树侧边栏，支持多种文件预览和编辑差异查看。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar for browsing artifacts and workspace files, previewing common formats, viewing edit diffs, and opening the panel in a separate browser tab.

capabilities: Reads workspace directory listings and file contents for browsing and preview
Tracks files produced or modified by supported agent tools and workspace command snapshots
Serves sidebar and popout preview data through local plugin routes
Stores interface settings in browser localStorage
Removes artifact entries from the plugin list without deleting disk files
